create_ISMCTSBot: create an ISMCTSBot instance for a pyspiel game with a custom evaluator and UCT parameters
run_ISMCTS_search: run IS-MCTS search on a game state and return a policy as action-probability pairs
select_action_with_tree_policy: select an action from a node using UCT or PUCT child selection policy
get_final_policy: get the final policy from a search tree node using visit count or max value strategy
run_simulation: run a recursive IS-MCTS simulation from a game state, expanding nodes and backpropagating returns
